g.text: MarieRank3Convo4 begins.

g.title: j3786031294
g.text: Boolean MarieLyonAvailable is now true.

g.title: j2006515349
g.text: วันก่อนฉันได้คุยกับ Monsieur Loid เกี่ยวกับวัยเด็กของเขา แล้วฉันก็มีคำถามจะถามคุณ

g.title: j2423514625
g.text: I'm sorry. You what?

g.title: j1242166038
g.text: I... don't... know how to feel about this.

g.title: j2420662274
g.text: อยากจะถามว่าอะไร?

g.title: j1610572375
g.text: [จบ]

g.title: j674156595
g.text: He was telling me about his youth. Ai-je fait quelque chose qui vous a offensé ?

g.title: j2650810591
g.text: I do not understand. Ai-je fait quelque chose qui vous avez offensé ?

g.title: j3685313169
g.text: Archimedeans - were they Orokin ? Or were they not ? The word gets used with such frivolity.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j1109443040
g.text: I guess I'm just... jealous.

g.title: j2920487442
g.text: I guess I'm just... surprised.

g.title: j649490114
g.text: I could ask the devil, I suppose. But I do not like to talk to him if I can help it.

g.title: j4227016362
g.text: De la jalousie ? Pourquoi ?

g.title: j1010099276
g.text: Pourquoi ?

g.title: j1414262014
g.text: ไม่ใช่ พวกอาร์คิมีดีนมีตำแหน่งต่ำกว่า Orokin

g.title: j863454030
g.text: Orokin Empire is called that because the Orokin ran it, but the Orokin was also just the name of the ruling class.

g.title: j2966120716
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2237609168
g.text: I'm just a little taken aback you know more about him now than I do.

g.title: j3812540503
g.text: I don't know anything about Loid's past, and I've known him for a while.

g.title: j3018428694
g.text: This happens a lot. You're not alone.

g.title: j2997233729
g.text: Oh ! Do not take it personally, s'il vous plaît !

g.title: j431440574
g.text: Did the Orokin purposefully make their society confusing and obtuse ?

g.title: j2068312749
g.text: Monsieur Loid is, what is the word, distant ?

g.title: j3625677585
g.text: Thousands of years of being in charge, and people get... bored. Bored people make complicated systems.

g.title: j1840121062
g.text: They had a taste for the ornate and the intricate. It extended to bureaucracy.

g.title: j107314503
g.text: Honestly? I'm starting to think so.

g.title: j647464481
g.text: I don't know anything about him, really.

g.title: j1804977012
g.text: He's a bit aloof, yes.

g.title: j4097027666
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2844830077
g.text: Look at with whom I spend my time with, oui ? Learn to read one statue and it is not too hard to learn to read another.

g.title: j4144166336
g.text: I think they did it just to be annoying !

g.title: j860820508
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1451255618
g.text: Et ils se demandent pourquoi des rébellions éclatent. Vous aviez peut-être vos warframes, mais nous avions nos guillotines !

g.title: j2568061881
g.text: Though I admit Monsieur Loid is a bit more... piquant than dear Lyon.

g.title: j3566713005
g.text: Vive la révolution !

g.title: j2821777160
g.text: He has his reasons.

g.title: j3807895228
g.text: Anyway... What was your question?

g.title: j1352858748
g.text: Should I be concerned?

g.title: j180122418
g.text: Vive la révolution ! I think.

g.title: j3875933892
g.text: I'm not quite sure what just happened, but I think I agree?

g.title: j2119335766
g.text: Yes, he certainly does.

g.title: j175852490
g.text: Ah ! Yes.

g.title: j907251828
g.text: Do not mind me, I am just having a bit of fun. Silly little Marie la révolutionnaire.

g.title: j1104976036
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2888020798
g.text: I fear I have entirely forgotten what I have come here to ask you now ! Ha ! Oh well. It will come to me.

g.title: j1696044100
g.text: Thank you for answering my question, I should let you go on your way.

g.title: j2631180450
g.text: I apologize for disrupting your day. Or evening. Or whatever time it is, whenever and wherever you have found yourself.

g.title: j4101990552
g.text: À la revoyure !
